<!--
  The sidebar of DashboardShell. Shapes: wide (icon and name), rail (icons only, the names still read),
  collapsed (the static collapsed state of a wide sidebar, with its expand button), twolevel (a rail beside a
  panel of the current section's links). side puts it at the start or the end.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ShellNav } from "../blocks/dashboard-shell.types";

  export type ShellSidebarProps = {
    nav: ShellNav;
    mode?: "wide" | "rail" | "collapsed" | "twolevel" | "none";
    side?: "start" | "end";
    brand?: "show" | "hide";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    ontoggle?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

  let {
    nav,
    mode = "wide",
    side = "start",
    brand = "show",
    landmarkLabel,
    ontoggle,
  }: ShellSidebarProps = $props();
  const named = $derived((mode as string) === "wide");
</script>

<Block
  tag="aside"
  class={cn(
    "flex shrink-0 bg-card",
    (
      (side as string) === "end" ? "flex-row-reverse border-l border-border"
      : "border-r border-border"
    )
  )}
  aria-label={(landmarkLabel ?? nav.label)}
  data-testid="sidebar"
  data-mode={mode}
>
  <Box class={cn("flex flex-col gap-6 py-4", (named ? "w-64 px-4" : "w-16 items-center px-2"))}>
    {#if ((brand as string) === "show")}
      <Group gap="2" align="center" class="shrink-0" data-testid="brand">
        <LucideIcon name="layers" size={24} />
        <Text size="base" weight="bold" class={(named ? "" : "sr-only")}>
          {nav.brand}
        </Text>
      </Group>
    {/if}
    <NavBlock
      label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", nav.label, landmarkLabel)) : nav.label)}
      class="flex-1"
    >
      <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0" data-testid="items">
        {#each nav.links as l (l.id)}
          <ListItem>
            <Link
              href="#/"
              variant="default"
              size="sm"
              aria-current={((l.id === nav.current) ? "page" : undefined)}
              class={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-4 rounded py-2",
                (named ? "px-4" : "justify-center px-2"),
                ((l.id === nav.current) ? "bg-muted font-medium" : "")
              )}
              data-testid="item"
            >
              <LucideIcon name={l.icon} size={16} />
              <Inline class={(named ? "" : "sr-only")}>
                {l.name}
              </Inline>
            </Link>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </NavBlock>
    {#if ((mode as string) === "collapsed")}
      <ButtonPlain
        type="button"
        class="inline-flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded text-muted-foreground"
        aria-label={nav.expand}
        aria-expanded={(((mode as string) === "wide") ? "true" : "false")}
        data-testid="toggle"
        onclick={() => ontoggle?.()}
      >
        <LucideIcon name="panel-left" size={20} />
      </ButtonPlain>
    {/if}
  </Box>
  {#if ((mode as string) === "twolevel")}
    <Box
      class={cn(
        "flex w-56 flex-col gap-4 px-4 py-6",
        (((side as string) === "end") ? "border-r border-border" : "border-l border-border")
      )}
      data-testid="subnav"
    >
      <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" class="px-4">
        {nav.subTitle}
      </Text>
      <NavBlock label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", nav.subTitle, landmarkLabel)) : nav.subTitle)}>
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          {#each nav.sub as s (s.id)}
            <ListItem>
              <Link
                href="#/"
                variant="default"
                size="sm"
                aria-current={((s.id === nav.subCurrent) ? "page" : undefined)}
                class={cn(
                  "flex items-center gap-4 rounded py-2",
                  (true ? "px-4" : "justify-center px-2"),
                  ((s.id === nav.subCurrent) ? "bg-muted font-medium" : "")
                )}
                data-testid="item"
              >
                <LucideIcon name={s.icon} size={16} />
                <Inline class={(true ? "" : "sr-only")}>
                  {s.name}
                </Inline>
              </Link>
            </ListItem>
          {/each}
        </List>
      </NavBlock>
    </Box>
  {/if}
</Block>
